org.portico.utils.fom

Class FomParser

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.utils.fom.FomParser

  • public class FomParser
extends Object
    This class is a wrapper for the various specific-specific FOM parsers. It will open and look at the given URL representing a FOM, determine the appropriate parser for its format and then parse it into an ObjectModel. See parse(URL).

    • Method Detail

      • parse

        public static ObjectModel parse(URL fedLocation)
                         throws JCouldNotOpenFED,
                                JErrorReadingFED
        There are a bunch of FOM parsers present in Portico for the various formats associated with the iterations of the standard. This method will try to open the given URL and interrogate it to determine which format it is in, and thus, which FOM parser should be used to read it. If this works happily, the FOM will be parsed and a populated instance of ObjectModel will be returned.

        This method will check what format the fed file is in and then will parse it into an ObjectModel or throw an exception if there is a problem. This will work with either HLA 1.3 files, IEEE1516-2000 XML-based files or IEEE1516e-2010 XML-based files. Thus, both types are supported through either interface.

        Parameters:
        fedLocation - The location of the FED file to parse.
        Returns:
        An ObjectModel instance containing the parsed contents of the given URL
        Throws:
        JCouldNotOpenFED - Could not open the fed file at the provided URL
        JErrorReadingFED - The FOM was either in an invalid format or contained errors
